title: Category or Subcategory Index
description: Metadata and routing rules for a category or subcategory folder.

description.description: What kinds of items appear here.

icon.description: Non-binding icon hint for tools. Format: namespace:path (e.g. minecraft:apple).

color.description: Non-binding color hint for tools. Hex format: #RRGGBB.

show_if_any.description: Facet IDs (path-style, e.g. natural/seed). Items with any of these facets appear in this subcategory.

priority.description: Routing priority hint for tools when an item qualifies for multiple subcategories. Default: normal.
